key_insight: vdW confinement in confined epitaxy does more than trap nuclei—it creates strong interfacial mechanical forces that help drive high-quality monolayer NbSe2 growth.
engineering_relevance: Designing growth interfaces to tune interfacial mechanics could improve scalable synthesis of high-quality 2D materials.
method: Modeled monolayer NbSe2 between c-plane sapphire and h-BN
Mapped the force-electronic landscape at the interface
evidence_signal: The abstract reports calculated forces of +0.070 eV/Å on Nb and -0.04 eV/Å on Se, with unit-cell interfacial interaction energy up to 2.4 eV.
watch_item: The conclusions are based on computed interface energetics, so experimental validation is still needed before using mechanochemical tuning as a design rule.
paper_title: Resolving the interfacial mechanical landscape of monolayer NbSe2 grown by confined epitaxy
